articles.title: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses Rs 100 Crore Worldwide Ahead of Release
articles.excerpt: Reported pre-sales of about Rs 105 crore, nearly 15 lakh tickets in India and $5 million overseas put Nitesh Tiwari's epic in select company two days before its November 5 opening.
articles.nri_angle: US paid previews have contributed more than $1.5 million of the film's $5 million overseas advance bookings ahead of the November 5 worldwide release.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ravie Dubey Unveiled as Lakshman in New Ramayana Poster Ahead of November 5 Release
articles.excerpt: The makers introduced Dubey as 'A devoted brother. A fearless warrior. Rama's shield.' The actor called playing Lakshman 'an honour and a responsibility' days before Part 1 opens worldwide.
articles.nri_angle: Ramayana Part 1 releases worldwide on November 5, 2026 in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam, with Sony Pictures handling distribution outside India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Go Sell Ice Cream': AR Rahman Answers Ramayana Song Critics With a Steve Jobs Line
articles.excerpt: Facing backlash over 'Mangal Rang', the Ramayana composer told Screen he is his own first critic, that tunes mature like pickles, and that pleasing everyone was never the brief, three days before the film opens.
articles.image_caption: A.R. Rahman at a press event, holding a microphone. The composer defended his Ramayana song 'Mangal Rang' against online criticism in an interview with Screen.
articles.nri_angle: Ramayana's November 5 worldwide release is a major diaspora theatrical event, and its music debate is playing out across Indian audiences globally.

articles.title: Ramayana: Part 1 — Critics Hail Nitesh Tiwari's Epic as a Visual Masterpiece
articles.excerpt: A stunning retelling of the ancient epic, though pacing and music draw mixed reactions.
articles.image_caption: Still from the official trailer of 'Ramayana: Part 1'.
articles.nri_angle: This film serves as a grand retelling of a beloved epic, making it a significant cultural touchstone for the diaspora, available in Hindi with subtitles.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.rating_consensus: Critics broadly praise the film's visual grandeur and performances, particularly highlighting Yash's portrayal of Ravana and Ranbir's role as Rama, while expressing concerns about pacing and musical depth — a 3.5-star consensus across multiple reviews.

articles.title: A.R. Rahman Becomes the Face of Brooke Bond Taj Mahal Tea
articles.excerpt: Hindustan Unilever's tea brand, whose "Wah Taj!" line was made famous by Ustad Zakir Hussain, has signed the Oscar-winning composer for a new campaign about the creative pause.
articles.image_caption: A.R. Rahman holds a cup of tea at a piano outdoors in the Taj Mahal Tea campaign film. Hindustan Unilever announced Rahman as the brand ambassador for Brooke Bond Taj Mahal Tea on November 2, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Rahman is one of Indian music's most recognized names abroad; diaspora audiences will meet the campaign film on the brand's digital platforms, where it is already live.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan Greets Fans From Behind Bulletproof Shield After Bomb Threat
articles.excerpt: The Sunday darshan at Jalsa went ahead under tight security, with Abhishek Bachchan beside his father, weeks after a threat email naming the bungalow reached Mumbai Police.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora fans who grew up on Bachchan's films, the fortified Sunday darshan at Jalsa shows a beloved ritual continuing under an active police investigation.

articles.title: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses 2 Lakh Tickets in National Chains for Opening Day
articles.excerpt: PVR Inox and Cinepolis sales for the November 5 opener rose from 1.70 lakh on Saturday to about 2 lakh by Sunday night, with all-India advances at 4.58 lakh tickets.
articles.image_caption: Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Yash as Ravana in stills from Ramayana: Part One. The film sold about 2 lakh opening-day tickets in India's top two national chains ahead of its November 5 release.
articles.nri_angle: The India advance builds on the $1.7 million North America presale diaspora audiences had already put down for the Diwali-weekend epic.

articles.title: Ramayana Has a Reported Rs 4,000 Crore Riding on It. Is the Buzz Big Enough?
articles.excerpt: Overseas presales crossed $2.5 million while a booking dispute stalled India — with the deadlock reportedly over, the next 48 hours give the first clean read on demand.
articles.image_caption: Ranbir Kapoor as Rama in a still from Ramayana: Part One. The film opens in theatres on November 5, with overseas advance sales past $2.5 million.
articles.nri_angle: North America supplied close to $1.9 million of the overseas presale, with paid previews on November 4 ahead of the November 5 opening.

articles.title: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 800 Crore, a First for Tamil Cinema
articles.excerpt: Trade trackers put Rajinikanth's sequel at Rs 800-807 crore worldwide after 18 days, with overseas markets supplying about a third of the gross.
articles.image_caption: Rajinikanth, holding a pistol, in a still from Jailer 2, in which he returns as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. The film crossed Rs 800 crore in worldwide gross in its third week, a first for Tamil cinema.
articles.nri_angle: Overseas markets supplied roughly a third of Jailer 2's record gross, underlining how central North American and Gulf audiences now are to a Tamil blockbuster.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.excerpt: The composer defends months of work behind Mangal Rang, explains how he and Hans Zimmer split the score, and talks about still getting nervous on stage.

articles.title: Ram Charan and Sukumar Launch RC17 as Chiranjeevi Gives the Mahurat Clap
articles.excerpt: The Rangasthalam pair reunited at a Hyderabad pooja ceremony on Sunday for the pan-India film backed by Mythri Movie Makers and T-Series. Title, cast and release date are still under wraps.
articles.image_caption: Ram Charan, Chiranjeevi and director Sukumar at the RC17 pooja ceremony in Hyderabad. The film, Charan and Sukumar's first collaboration since Rangasthalam, was launched on November 1.
articles.nri_angle: A Telugu pan-India production presented by T-Series is built for simultaneous national and overseas release; US showtimes will follow once the title and date are announced.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jailer 2 First Indian Film to Cross Rs 75 Crore in All Four South Markets
articles.excerpt: Rajinikanth's sequel completed the milestone in Kerala on its 16th day, finishing a four-market run that eluded Baahubali 2, KGF Chapter 2 and Pushpa 2, according to Sacnilk.
articles.image_caption: Poster art for Jailer 2, with Rajinikanth flanked by Mohanlal and Shivarajkumar. The film crossed Rs 75 crore in each of the four major South Indian markets within 16 days, according to Sacnilk.
articles.nri_angle: Jailer 2's overseas gross of Rs 267.50 crore in 16 days, per Sacnilk, underlines the diaspora's weight in a Tamil blockbuster's economics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ramayana Review: Critics Hail the Spectacle, Split on the Storytelling
articles.excerpt: Bollywood Hungama gave Nitesh Tiwari's Hindi epic a perfect 5/5, but international critics who saw the English dub ranged from IGN's 4/10 to Screen Rant's 7/10 — praising the scale, score and Yash's Ravana while faulting the pacing and crowding.
articles.image_caption: A still from Ramayana: Part 1 shows Rama standing before a waterfall. Critics praised the film's scale and spectacle while dividing on its storytelling.
articles.nri_angle: The film opens in US theatres on November 5 in both Hindi and English, and the split between Indian and international critics maps directly onto the choice diaspora viewers face between the original Hindi cut and the English dub.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

critics.name: Taran Adarsh
critics.verdict: Ramayana is not merely a film; IT'S AN EXPERIENCE. It is a film that makes India proud.

critics.name: Christian Zilko
critics.verdict: Calling “Ramayana” epic may be a cliche, but there's really no other word that would suffice.

critics.name: Brandon Zachary
critics.verdict: On a purely visual and technical level, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend is an impressive cinematic achievement.

critics.name: Giovanni Lago
critics.verdict: Audiences can still be swept up by “Ramayana,” even if it feels so stuffed at times that it might've needed a “Game of Thrones”-level television adaptation to flesh out its narrative fully.

critics.name: Siddhant Adlakha
critics.verdict: A majestic epic falls victim to clunky action, eye-sore CGI, and awkward AI lip-syncing in what is, unfortunately, just a Part 1.

articles.title: Sanjay Gupta, Director of Kaante and Kaabil, Dies in Mumbai at 57
articles.excerpt: The filmmaker behind a generation of stylised Hindi crime dramas died at home on October 30 after a fall, colleagues and police reports say. He is survived by his wife, Anu Lekhi.
articles.nri_angle: Gupta's Kaante was shot in Los Angeles and his crime films were staples of diaspora video stores and streaming queues for two decades.

articles.title: Salman Khan Eyed for Cop Role Opposite Sanjay Dutt in Khalnayak Returns
articles.excerpt: Mid-Day reports Subhash Ghai's writers are building a good-Samaritan police officer around Salman for the Khalnayak sequel — but Ghai says scripting is still on and nothing is locked.
articles.image_caption: Salman Khan in a police uniform in a file image, beside the Khalnayak Returns poster showing Sanjay Dutt as Ballu. The sequel's writers are reported to be developing the cop role for Khan, though his casting has not been confirmed.

articles.title: Jailer 2 Hindi Earns Rs 43.8 Crore in 15 Days, Books 68% Profit Over Breakeven
articles.excerpt: Rajinikanth's Tamil film, released in Hindi dubbed version on October 15, has crossed its Rs 26 crore breakeven with Rs 17.8 crore in profit, Koimoi reported — while the all-language India net total reached Rs 429.55 crore and worldwide gross Rs 766.65 crore, according to Sacnilk.
articles.nri_angle: The Hindi version's profit run matters to North Indian and diaspora audiences who discovered the Tamil original on streaming; the film now has six days of clear run before Ramayana Part One arrives.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ramayana Presales: Canada and US Diaspora Buy 88,772 Tickets Worth $1.7 Million
articles.excerpt: North America is Ramayana: Part One's biggest overseas market, with premiere shows alone selling 29,175 tickets for $647,400 ahead of the November 5 release.
articles.nri_angle: Canadian and US diaspora audiences have bought 88,772 Ramayana presale tickets worth $1.7 million, making North America the film's top overseas market.

articles.image_caption: Ahan Shetty, who began shooting the Hindi action drama Sanki in Bhopal on October 30.

articles.nri_angle: The India-themed edition puts diaspora figures including Padma Lakshmi, Freida Pinto, Rupi Kaur and Anoushka Shankar alongside India-based talent.

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Earns $6.71 Million in North America, Beating Drishyam 2 by 81 Percent
articles.excerpt: Koimoi puts the Ajay Devgn thriller at $6.71 million (Rs 63.88 crore) in the US and Canada after 26 days, 81.35 percent above Drishyam 2's lifetime $3.7 million and a North American career best for Devgn.
articles.nri_angle: Drishyam 3's $6.71 million North American gross shows US and Canadian audiences sustaining a Hindi thriller for 26 days, making it Ajay Devgn's biggest film in the territory.

articles.nri_angle: North American paid previews for November 4 had already generated more than $550,000 by October 26, giving US and Canadian audiences an early read on the epic's overseas demand ahead of its November 5 release.

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Will Open in India a Day Before the US, Marvel Confirms in Diwali Surprise
articles.excerpt: Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans announced in a Marvel India Diwali video that the film releases in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026 — a day ahead of the US — in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu.
articles.image_caption: Doctor Doom appears alongside Chris Evans and Robert Downey Jr. in Marvel India's Diwali announcement video. Avengers: Doomsday will release in India on December 17, a day before the United States.
articles.nri_angle: US-based Marvel fans will get the film on December 18 — a day after India — so diaspora viewers who want to stay spoiler-free should plan for opening weekend and mute social feeds on December 17.

articles.title: PVR INOX Posts Record Quarter as India Box Office Crosses Rs 4,000 Crore
articles.excerpt: India's gross box office reached Rs 4,443 crore in July-September, the first quarter above Rs 4,000 crore, as PVR INOX profit more than doubled to Rs 273 crore.
articles.image_caption: PVR INOX Superplex Mall of India in Noida. PVR INOX reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs 2,133 crore in Q2 FY27, up 17% year on year, with profit after tax up 111% to Rs 273.3 crore.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Pooja.sirsat26 via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)
articles.nri_angle: Record Indian box office across Hindi, regional and Hollywood films signals a theatrical slate diaspora audiences will see in US and UK cinemas in the coming months.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jailer 2 Dips 20 Percent on Tuesday, India Gross Reaches Rs 462.75 Crore
articles.excerpt: Pinkvilla puts the second-Tuesday gross at Rs 8.75 crore and the India total at Rs 462.75 crore, while Sacnilk's nett count stands at Rs 415.65 crore with worldwide gross near Rs 744 crore.
articles.image_caption: Rajinikanth appears in character as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, wearing black-framed glasses and a light shirt. Jailer 2 has reached Rs 462.75 crore gross in India in 13 days, according to Pinkvilla.
articles.nri_angle: Overseas markets contributed about Rs 257.50 crore of the film's roughly Rs 744 crore worldwide gross, underlining diaspora turnout in North America and the Gulf.

articles.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences, Love & War's confirmed Hindi, Tamil and Telugu release and Varanasi's Priyanka Chopra Jonas casting make two of these the most likely wide overseas releases on the list.
